title: Keg Repository Configuration
description: Per-repository sandbox configuration (.keg.yaml). Versioned with the repository, contains no machine-specific host paths.

version.description: Repo config schema version (currently only '1' is supported).

vars.description: Repo-local variables for Go template replacement (e.g. {{ .Vars.key }}).

templates.description: Built-in language templates that provide standard toolchain environment variables and cache mounts.

bwrap_args.description: Raw bubblewrap arguments appended to the generated bwrap command (isolation-weakening flags require security.allow_weak_bwrap in user config).

mounts.description: Additional filesystem mounts inside the sandbox.

secrets.description: Secrets required by the sandbox, resolved from user config secret_sources or secrets map into /run/secrets/<name>.

ports.description: Port forward back-channel exposing sandbox services on host loopback or specified IP.

forward_hosts.description: Host-port forwarding mapping host/network services into sandbox loopback.

delegated_tasks.description: Host-only task whitelist for delegation from inside the sandbox via 'just delegate' or raw execution.

trust_anchors.description: Optional list of files within the repository to track cryptographically as trust anchors alongside .keg.yaml.

unset.description: Environment variables to actively remove from the sandbox.

set.description: Environment variables to set in the sandbox (supports Go template expressions like {{ .Vars.foo }}).

inherit.description: Explicit host environment variables to pass into the sandbox.

inherit_all.description: Pass through all host environment variables (except sensitive credentials and proxy settings).

src.description: Source path on host (supports Go template expressions like {{ .Vars.mock_data }}).

dest.description: Destination path inside sandbox (required unless mode is tmpfs).

mode.description: Mount mode: ro (read-only), rw (read-write), dev (device bind), tmpfs, ephemeral (tmpfs overlay), or disk (persistent disk overlay).

name.description: Secret identifier defined in user config (mounted at /run/secrets/<name>).

env.description: Optional environment variable set to /run/secrets/<name> inside the sandbox.

name.description: Logical name for the port mapping (required if dynamic is true).

host_ip.description: Host IP address to bind the listener to (defaults to 127.0.0.1).

dynamic.description: Allocate host port dynamically and pass via KEG_PORT_<name> env variable.

guest_port.description: Port number to listen on inside the sandbox (127.0.0.1).

target_host.description: Target hostname or IP address on host/network.

mode.description: Network egress mode: 'proxy' (HTTP/HTTPS proxy only), 'transparent' (SNI/TCP redirect), or 'both'.

dns.description: DNS resolution settings and static host mappings.

sni_domains.description: Whitelisted domain names for HTTP/HTTPS proxy and transparent SNI filter (exact or wildcard like *.example.com).

tcp_endpoints.description: Allowed raw TCP destinations (host + ports) for transparent mode.

upstream.description: Upstream DNS resolver IP:port (empty uses host resolver).

hosts.description: Static DNS host mappings (exact or wildcard *.domain -> IP).

ports.description: List of allowed TCP port numbers (1..65535).

exact.description: Exact task names allowed to run on host without arguments.

prefixes.description: Task name prefixes allowed to run on host with arguments.

raw.description: Raw binary execution rules executed directly on host without just wrapping (e.g. git, podman).

subcommands.description: Allowed subcommands (the first non-option argument must match one of these).

opts_with_value.description: Global options that consume the next argument (e.g. '-c', '-C', '--format').

allow_opt_value_form.description: Allow option=value syntax for global options (e.g. '--opt=val').
